question: Identify the artist who is NOT related to the Carnatic music family.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Begum Akhtar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Begum Akhtar was a renowned Indian singer of Ghazal, Dadra, and Thumri genres of Hindustani classical music.

• She is known as the Queen of Ghazals and was one of the most famous performers of light classical music.

• Begum Akhtar was awarded the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan by the Government of India for her contributions to the field of music.

• She is not associated with Carnatic music, which is a form of classical music that originated in South India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **TS Vinayakram**

• TS Vinayakram, also known as Vikku Vinayakram, is an Indian percussionist and a leading exponent of the ghatam, a traditional South Indian clay pot instrument.

• He has contributed significantly to Carnatic music and has performed globally.

• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contributions to Indian classical music.

• **Aruna Sairam**

• Aruna Sairam is an acclaimed Carnatic vocalist from South India.

• She is known for her versatile voice and has performed extensively in India and abroad.

• Aruna Sairam has been honored with several awards, including the Padma Shri and the Sangita Kalanidhi.

• **MS Subbulakshmi**

• MS Subbulakshmi, often referred to as MS Amma, was one of the greatest Carnatic vocalists of all time.

• She was the first musician to be awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor.

• Her renditions of classical compositions are considered legendary in the world of Carnatic music.

• **Carnatic Music**

• Carnatic music is a system of music commonly associated with the southern part of the Indian subcontinent.

• It is one of the two main subgenres of Indian classical music that evolved from ancient Hindu traditions.

• Carnatic music is characterized by its use of complex rhythms, intricate patterns, and a strong emphasis on vocal performance.
